info.name: Webex Admin Address Book ECM folder linking API

params.name: roomId
params.description: ID of the room for which to list the ECM folder.

items.docs: Lists the ECM folder of a room specified by the `roomId` query parameter.

Adds an existing ECM folder to a room as (default or reference) file storage. There is no data validation happening for the request. Please ensure the correct `driveId` and `itemId.` These can be collected from the MS Graph API. The `contentUrl` and `displayName` are used only for user convenience. The folder will be configured with the MS folder name as `displayName`, and the `contentURL` may be updated or corrected as needed. To assess final configuration, please make a GET request on the link

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier for the folder.

items.docs: Get details for a room ECM folder with the specified folder id.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier for the room folder.

items.docs: Updates the configuration of the specified Room folder. There is no data validation happening for the request. Please ensure the correct `driveId` and `itemId.` These can be collected from the MS Graph API. The `contentUrl` and `displayName` are used only for user convenience. The folder will be configured with the MS folder name as `displayName`, and the `contentURL` may be updated or corrected as needed. To assess final configuration, please make a GET request on the linkedFolder.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier for the folder to disassociate from the space.

items.docs: Unlinks the room-linked folder with the specified ID from the space.
